verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs confirm on-reader tipping: the card reader suggests tips to customers before collecting payment, and tips can be collected before or after authorization. Nothing in the pack shows how a merchant configures those prompts. Missing for 10: documented configuration of tip percentages, smart/fixed tip amounts, custom tip entry, a merchant-ops configuration surface (Dashboard or API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal
